predictions.articleTitle: Achilles Veen vs Dongen Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Leaky Defenses Fuel an Away Breakthrough?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Dongen's 2.00 goals-per-game attack against Achilles Veen's 2.50 goals-conceded rate makes Draw / Away Win alongside Over 2.5 goals the balanced core projection.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win driven by Dongen's 54.6% Poisson win share and Achilles Veen's second-half defensive collapses (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 goals supported by a 3.75 combined Poisson lambda and 72.3% three-plus goal probability (Confidence: High, Value: High)
2:2 Draw contingency protecting against Dongen's 2.17 goals-conceded rate and winless documented away league form (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Dongen's 2.00 goals-per-game attack targets Veen's 2.50 conceded rate.

spf.comment: Covers the primary 1:2 away win from Dongen's attacking edge and the 2:2 draw branch driven by Dongen's road defensive leaks, where a single away call would ignore their winless documented away run.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.75 combined Poisson lambda, 72.3% Over 2.5 density, and defenses conceding 2.50 and 2.17 goals per match.

score.comment: 1:2 is the top Poisson cell (8.9%) reflecting Dongen's edge, while 2:2 (6.7%) captures Dongen's away defensive vulnerability.

goals.comment: 3 goals (20.7%) and 4 goals (19.4%) hold the top two probabilities in the Poisson distribution around a 3.75 total lambda.

bqc.comment: Expects a tight first half before Dongen either pull away after the break (Draw-Loss) or trade second-half goals to share points (Draw-Draw).
